description: The handpan buyer's resource. Choose the right scale, maker, and budget for your first instrument without relying on affiliate lists.

authors.name: Handpano Editorial Team
authors.bio: A dedicated team evaluating handpan makers and scales.

editorial.testing: We buy or borrow every handpan we test. We do not accept free instruments in exchange for coverage.
editorial.monetization: We make money through our own buyer's decision guide and direct lessons. We do not use affiliate links.
editorial.corrections: We correct factual errors promptly and note significant updates at the top of the relevant article.
